name: Yellow-Sailed Schooner

items.name: Unfurl Yellow Sails
items.text: With the pull of a rope, the pilot or one of the crew unfurls the yellow sails that Okeno freebooters are so infamous for. Each enemy creature within a 100-foot emanation who can see the sails must succeed at a DC 26 Will save save or become Frightened 1 (or Frightened 2 on a critical failure). Regardless of the save's results, the creature is temporarily immune to Unfurl Yellow Sails for 24 hours.

text: Hailing from Okeno, this schooner usually keeps its allegiance a secret until it gets within boarding range and unfurls its saffron-colored sails.
